purpose: Position a named notification dot or count around existing content while preserving child interaction.
behaviorProvider: Native noninteractive markup; Indicator composes CountBadge for count rendering.

component: Render the child unchanged inside a reserved-space wrapper. The marker does not intercept pointer events and never changes the child accessible name or event handlers.
Omitted count selects a dot. Normalize finite counts to nonnegative whole numbers; hide non-finite values and zero unless showZero. hidden removes only the marker.
host: Provide the complete accessible label including raw meaningful count; name interactive children separately.
Own notification data, announcement policy and zero visibility. Use decorative only when accessible surrounding content already conveys the same information.

requirements.statement: Render the child unchanged inside a reserved-space wrapper. The marker does not intercept pointer events and never changes the child accessible name or event handlers.
Omitted count selects a dot. Normalize finite counts to nonnegative whole numbers; hide non-finite values and zero unless showZero. hidden removes only the marker.
Normalize max to a positive whole cap and pass the count to the shared small inverted CountBadge. The supplied label, not the capped display, names the marker.
Expose a named image marker unless decorative; decorative hides marker semantics. Logical start/end corner placement follows writing direction. Do not create a live region.
Provide the complete accessible label including raw meaningful count; name interactive children separately.
Own notification data, announcement policy and zero visibility. Use decorative only when accessible surrounding content already conveys the same information.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation and preserve CountBadge/child component ownership. Validate all four theme/mode mappings, logical directions and compact layout without changing dimensions between themes.

limitations: No notification service, action callback or live update announcement is supplied.
The wrapper reserves a small corner inset; very small target content still requires visual review with long counts.
Written coverage is separate from actual browser, visual, accessibility and package evidence.
